{{Quote|Ah, the 'Detritus Satellites'. A peculiar "collection" of droids. ''[...]'' All I could want with them and their technology is to see how much of an explosion they would cause under the heat of my fire.|A'kiian "Maleficus" Bloodlight|<ref name="SWG:AL" />}}
'''A'kiian "Maleficus" Bloodlight''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Black Sun formed an alliance with the [[Detritus Satellites]], a group of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="SWG:AL" /> [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class]] droid scavengers active in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found an information storage device in the remains of a destroyed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the Dantooine system. It contained a private message from Bloodlight. In this message, Bloodlight voiced a strong disapproval of an alliance agreement between Black Sun and the Detritus Satellites. Bloodlight regretted that the agreement included a non-aggression pact, but hoped that it would be possible to destroy a few [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] "under the radar".<ref name="SWG:AL" />

==Behind the scenes==
A'kiian "Maleficus" Bloodlight is the author of a message found on a rare information storage deviced named "[[W:c:swg:A Log|A Log]]" that can be [[Wikipedia:Looting (gaming)|looted]] from starfighters in the Dantooine system in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG:AL" />
